note: Published dimensions and gross section properties, from the public manufacturer catalogues named per family. Every value is the table's; the app compares its own computed properties with them. Check against the current edition before design use.

UB.name: Universal beam
UB.source: InfraBuild, Hot Rolled and Structural Steel Products, 9th Edition (October 2019), Table 9 (Universal Beams, Dimensions and Properties)

UC.name: Universal column
UC.source: InfraBuild, Hot Rolled and Structural Steel Products, 9th Edition (October 2019), Table 11 (Universal Columns, Dimensions and Properties)

PFC.name: Parallel flange channel
PFC.source: InfraBuild, Hot Rolled and Structural Steel Products, 9th Edition (October 2019), Table 15 (Parallel Flange Channels, Dimensions and Properties)

EA.name: Equal angle
EA.source: InfraBuild, Hot Rolled and Structural Steel Products, 9th Edition (October 2019), Table 19 (Equal Angles, x-axis and y-axis) and Table 21 (n-axis and p-axis)

UA.name: Unequal angle
UA.source: InfraBuild, Hot Rolled and Structural Steel Products, 9th Edition (October 2019), Table 22 (Unequal Angles, x-axis and y-axis) and Table 24 (n-axis and p-axis)

CHS.name: Circular hollow section
CHS.source: Australian Tube Mills, Design Capacity Tables for Structural Steel Hollow Sections (August 2013), Tables 3.1-1 and 3.1-2 (Circular Hollow Sections, Dimensions and Properties)

SHS.name: Square hollow section
SHS.source: Australian Tube Mills, Design Capacity Tables for Structural Steel Hollow Sections (August 2013), Tables 3.1-5 and 3.1-6 (Square Hollow Sections, Dimensions and Properties); corner radii per its Figure 3.2

RHS.name: Rectangular hollow section
RHS.source: Australian Tube Mills, Design Capacity Tables for Structural Steel Hollow Sections (August 2013), Tables 3.1-3 and 3.1-4 (Rectangular Hollow Sections, Dimensions and Properties); corner radii per its Figure 3.2

C.name: Cold-formed lipped C (purlin)
C.source: LYSAGHT Zeds & Cees Purlins and Girts User Guide (BlueScope Lysaght): Dimensions of Zeds & Cees, and Section Properties (Cees); inside bend radius 5 mm from its section figure

Z.name: Cold-formed lipped Z (purlin)
Z.source: LYSAGHT Zeds & Cees Purlins and Girts User Guide (BlueScope Lysaght): Dimensions of Zeds & Cees, and Section Properties (Zeds); inside bend radius 5 mm from its section figure

FL.name: Flat bar
FL.source: InfraBuild, Hot Rolled and Structural Steel Products, 9th Edition (October 2019), Table 5 (Flats, Size Availability and Mass): width, thickness and mass; the properties are a rectangle's

ROD.name: Round bar
ROD.source: InfraBuild, Hot Rolled and Structural Steel Products, 9th Edition (October 2019), Table 3 (Rounds, Size Availability and Mass): diameter and mass; the properties are a circle's
